pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Standing in a Patch of Grass with Its Trumpet Shaped Snout and Broad Base Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter stands among grass tufts in this printable coloring page, with a trumpet-shaped snout and overlapping leaves at its base. The coloring sheet centers its large round head above a curved stem, leaving broad spaces inside the leaves and a mostly open background.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Shooting a Pea at a Browncoat Zombie Approaching Along a Lawn Lane Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter fires a round pea toward an approaching Browncoat Zombie in this printable coloring page, showing the two Plants vs. Zombies characters across a lawn lane. The zombie reaches forward in a torn jacket and striped tie. Horizontal grass borders divide the coloring sheet, with smaller details in the fingers, teeth, and ragged clothing.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Beside a Sunflower Producing Sun Above the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page pairs a Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter with a smiling Sunflower beneath a large sun, with a picket fence behind the garden. Rounded petals surround Sunflower's face, while broad leaves spread around both stems. The coloring sheet combines large character shapes with narrow fence slats, sun rays, and scattered grass tufts.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Firing From Behind a Wall-nut Blocking a Conehead Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter fires from behind Wall-nut in this printable coloring page as a Conehead Zombie approaches across the Plants vs. Zombies lawn beside a picket fence. Wall-nut's wavy shell sits between the attacker and the plant, with a pea flying overhead. The coloring sheet includes the tall traffic cone, torn clothing, bushes, and patches of grass.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Firing Peas Through Torchwood and Turning Them into Fireballs Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter sends a pea through Torchwood in this printable coloring page, with a flaming projectile emerging beyond the burning stump in a Plants vs. Zombies scene. Tall outlined flames rise from Torchwood's cut top, above its frowning face and spreading roots. The coloring sheet leaves the background open around the plants and fireball.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter on a Lily Pad Shooting Across the Pool at a Ducky Tube Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter firing from a lily pad toward a Ducky Tube Zombie floating across a rippling pool. The duck-shaped swim ring surrounds the zombie's waist, and a pea travels between the characters. Poolside bricks, distant bushes, and curved water lines add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Protected Inside a Pumpkin Shell While a Zombie Approaches Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter rises from a protective Pumpkin shell in this printable coloring page while a ragged Plants vs. Zombies zombie approaches across a lightly outlined lawn. The large shell has slanted eyes, a triangular nose, and a wide carved grin. This coloring sheet contrasts its broad ribbed sections with the zombie's striped tie and torn cuffs.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter in a Rooftop Flower Pot Beneath an Umbrella Leaf Deflecting a Catapult Zombie Basketball Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Peashooter in a rooftop flower pot beneath Umbrella Leaf, which deflects a basketball launched by a distant Plants vs. Zombies Catapult Zombie. Curved motion lines trace the ball above the broad leaf, while rows of roof tiles cross the foreground. The coloring sheet also shows the catapult's wheels and throwing arm.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter and Puff Shroom Defending the Night Lawn as Zombies Emerge Among Gravestones Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter and Puff Shroom defend a moonlit lawn in this printable coloring page as Plants vs. Zombies enemies emerge beside cracked gravestones beneath scattered stars. Both plants fire toward the approaching zombies, with spots across the mushroom cap. The coloring sheet includes a crescent moon, a picket fence, bushes, and small grass patches between the characters.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Firing Peas That Strike a Screen Door Zombie Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter fires peas at a Screen Door Zombie in this printable coloring page, with starburst impacts appearing against the rectangular mesh shield held in front. The Plants vs. Zombies attacker grips both sides of the frame while stepping forward in ragged clothes. Fine diagonal mesh lines contrast with the broad plant leaves on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Shooting Holes Through a Newspaper Zombie Newspaper Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Peashooter shooting holes through a Newspaper Zombie's open newspaper, with round peas and torn paper fragments marking the Plants vs. Zombies attack. The zombie holds the spread pages beneath a wide-open mouth, wearing ripped clothing and cracked shoes. Newspaper panels and jagged impact holes provide smaller sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Looking Up as a Bungee Zombie Descends Toward Its Planting Square Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter looks upward in this printable coloring page as a Bungee Zombie descends toward its planting square, hanging from a cord above the Plants vs. Zombies lawn. Straps and buckles wrap around the zombie's torso as both hands reach down. The coloring sheet places these smaller details above broad leaves and a simple grid of ground squares.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Confronting a Pole Vaulting Zombie Leaping Over a Wall Nut Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter faces a Pole Vaulting Zombie in this printable coloring page, with the airborne attacker stretching above Wall-nut while gripping a long pole over the lawn. A headband, running shoes, and athletic shorts distinguish the zombie. The coloring sheet includes Wall-nut's ridged shell and a picket fence.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Fighting a Ground Zombie While Cactus Shoots at a Balloon Zombie Overhead Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Peashooter targeting a ground zombie while Cactus fires upward at a Balloon Zombie, suspended from a large balloon above the lawn. Triangular spines line the tall cactus, and a flower crowns its head. The coloring sheet also shows the airborne zombie's harness buckle.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Facing a Peashooter Zombie with a Plant Head and Zombie Body in Zombotany Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter confronts its Zombotany counterpart in this printable coloring page, facing a zombie body topped with a matching plant head and trumpet-shaped snout on the lawn. The taller figure wears a striped tie, ragged jacket, and oversized shoes. Scattered grass leaves the two figures prominent on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter in a Zen Garden Pot While Crazy Dave Waters It Coloring Page
pages.description: Crazy Dave waters a potted Peashooter in this printable coloring page, standing beside the plant in a Plants vs. Zombies Zen Garden with stepping stones nearby. His saucepan hat and bushy beard sit above a plain shirt. Water droplets, a garden lantern, and wooden platforms provide smaller coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Using Plant Food and Transforming into a Rapid Firing Gatling Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter transforms into its rapid-firing Gatling form in this printable coloring page, sending a spread of peas from clustered barrels beneath a large Plant Food leaf symbol. Flying leaves and long motion strokes surround the plant. The coloring sheet pairs small circular openings with a broad head and base leaves.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Riding in a Wild West Minecart While Firing at a Cowboy Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: A minecart carries Peashooter through the Wild West in this printable coloring page as it fires toward a Cowboy Zombie beside a timber-framed mine entrance and tracks. The attacker wears a broad hat, neckerchief, and torn trousers. Wooden cart panels, railway sleepers, and distant cacti fill the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Shooting at a Barrel Roller Zombie Pushing a Barrel Along a Pirate Seas Plank Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Peashooter firing at a Barrel Roller Zombie pushing a large barrel along the Pirate Seas planks, with a ship's sail behind them. Metal bands encircle the barrel beneath the pirate's hands. Knotted ropes, deck nails, and rippling water add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Firing at the Linked Camel Picture Tablets Carried by Camel Zombies in Ancient Egypt Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter attacks linked camel-picture tablets in this printable coloring page, facing three Camel Zombies holding cracked panels across a sandy Ancient Egypt scene with a distant pyramid. An impact burst marks the center tablet. Wrapped legs, sandals, and small connecting loops create finer details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Shooting at the Force Field Protecting a Future Zombie in Far Future Coloring Page
pages.description: A pea flies toward a Future Zombie's protective force field in this printable coloring page, with Peashooter facing the curved barrier across large tiled floor panels. The zombie wears a visor and an antenna backpack. Small electrical marks around the shield contrast with the broad outlines on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter on a Lily Pad Confronting a Surfer Zombie Riding a Wave at Big Wave Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Peashooter on a lily pad confronting a Surfer Zombie riding a curling wave, with a distant palm tree at Big Wave Beach. The surfer balances barefoot on a long board in flower-patterned shorts. Wave crests, water droplets, and broad leaves divide the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Aiming at a Relic Hunter Zombie Swinging on a Rope Through Lost City Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter aims upward at a rope-swinging Relic Hunter Zombie in this printable coloring page, beneath jungle branches beside the stepped stone ruins of Lost City and surrounding plants. The zombie wears a torn hat, boots, and a shoulder bag. Hanging vines and cracked masonry add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Firing Down a Garden Lane While Chomper Ambushes a Second Zombie Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter fires along one garden lane in this printable coloring page while Chomper opens its tooth-filled mouth behind a second zombie in a neighboring lane nearby. A picket fence runs across the background. Chomper's spotted head, triangular teeth, and the zombies' striped ties provide distinct coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Wearing a Christmas Hat Beside Snow-covered Garden Plants Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas hat tops Peashooter in this printable coloring page, surrounded by snow-covered plants and a garden fence with rounded snow caps resting along the wooden posts. A pom-pom hangs beside its large head. Broad snowdrifts, base leaves, and a nearby flower give the coloring sheet open sections.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Snow Pea Firing an Icy Pea at a Zombie with Frost Forming Around Its Feet Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Pea fires an icy projectile toward a zombie in this printable coloring page, with pointed frost crystals rising around the attacker's shoes beneath ragged trousers. Angular crystals also fan behind the plant's head. The coloring sheet contrasts their small facets with the round pea, broad leaves, and open background.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies 2 Fire Peashooter Thawing a Nearby Frozen Plant in Frostbite Caves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fire Peashooter thawing a frozen plant in Frostbite Caves, with curling heat marks directed toward a cracked block of ice nearby. Flames surround the shooter's head beneath long hanging icicles. Broken ice pieces and jagged cave walls add smaller shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Repeater Firing a Closely Spaced Pair of Peas at a Buckethead Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: Repeater fires two closely spaced peas toward a Buckethead Zombie in this printable coloring page, showing the Plants vs. Zombies pair facing each other against an open background. The bucket's curved handle hangs beside the zombie's head. Broad leaves, a striped tie, and ragged cuffs divide the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Threepeater Firing from Three Separate Heads into Three Neighboring Lawn Lanes Coloring Page
pages.description: Threepeater fires from three separate heads in this printable coloring page, spreading its shots across neighboring lawn lanes marked by simple horizontal borders and grass tufts. Curving stems join the heads above overlapping base leaves. Each round pea and flared snout forms a distinct open shape on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Split Pea Firing Backward at a Digger Zombie Emerging Behind the Plant Defenses Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Split Pea firing backward at a Digger Zombie emerging from a mound of earth behind the plant's two oppositely facing heads. The zombie carries a pickaxe and wears a lamp-equipped helmet. Pebbles, grass tufts, and the helmet straps add small coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Gatling Pea Wearing Its Military Helmet and Firing Four Peas Toward a Football Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: Gatling Pea wears a military helmet in this printable coloring page while firing four peas toward a running Football Zombie in shoulder pads and a faceguard. Four short barrels cluster at the plant's snout. Cleat studs, knee pads, and scattered grass provide smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Pea Pod with Five Pea Shooting Heads Defending a Wild West Rail Crossing Coloring Page
pages.description: Five Pea Pod heads fire beside a Wild West rail crossing in this printable coloring page, stacked vertically along a curved pod above spreading base leaves. A wooden crossbuck stands beyond the tracks against distant mesas. The coloring sheet includes circular peas, railway sleepers, and small bolts along the rails.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Primal Peashooter Knocking a Jurassic Zombie Backward with a Rock Like Pea Coloring Page
pages.description: Primal Peashooter strikes a Jurassic Zombie with a rock-like pea in this printable coloring page, sending small fragments outward as the attacker leans backward beside ferns. The plant has jagged foliage, while the zombie wears a spotted tunic and tooth-shaped belt ornaments. These textures contrast across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Electric Peashooter Firing an Electric Orb Through a Line of Zombies with Branching Sparks Coloring Page
pages.description: An electric orb travels through two zombies in this printable coloring page, with Electric Peashooter firing from the foreground as branching sparks surround the ragged attackers. Sharp zigzag shapes crown the plant's head and connect the impact bursts. Broad leaves balance the narrower lightning outlines on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Shadow Peashooter Powered by Moonflower and Firing a Piercing Shadow Bolt Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow Peashooter fires a pointed shadow bolt beside Moonflower in this printable coloring page, with curling outlines surrounding its head and diamond-shaped markings above its eyes. Moonflower's crescent-shaped petal rises above its smiling face. The coloring sheet leaves an open background around the plants, broad leaves, and arrow-shaped projectile.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Goo Peashooter Firing a Poisonous Pea That Coats and Slows an Approaching Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: Goo Peashooter fires a dripping pea at an approaching zombie in this printable coloring page, coating its ragged jacket and trousers with long rounded splashes of goo. Droplets also hang from the plant's head and snout. A picket fence and small puddles complete the garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Sling Pea Launching Several Peas in High Arcs Toward Zombies in Different Lawn Lanes Coloring Page
pages.description: Sling Pea launches several peas in high arcs in this printable coloring page, aiming toward zombies standing in different lawn lanes beyond its curled pod-shaped body. Rounded peas nest inside the open husk beneath the shooter's head. Sweeping trajectory lines cross the open spaces of the garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Snap Pea Swallowing a Zombie While Another Zombie Approaches Down the Lane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snap Pea swallowing a zombie while another approaches along the lane, with dangling legs protruding from the plant's wide tooth-lined mouth. Curled tendrils surround the large head and stem. A smaller pea-shaped face inside the jaws adds another outlined detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Mega Gatling Pea Unleashing a Rapid Volley from Its Multiple Barreled Snout Coloring Page
pages.description: Mega Gatling Pea unleashes a rapid volley in this printable coloring page, wearing a broad helmet as round peas scatter from its multiple-barreled snout toward the right. Short motion strokes surround the projectiles. The coloring sheet keeps the background empty around the circular barrel openings, helmet band, and broad leaves.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Peashooter Growing Inside Pea Vine as Both Plants Fire Down the Same Lane Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter grows inside Pea Vine in this printable coloring page, with both plants firing along the same garden lane beneath a picket fence and rounded bushes. Curling vines wrap around the larger plant's base leaves. Two rows of round peas extend across the open middle of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Heroes Green Shadow in Her Mask and Cape Unleashing Precision Blast Coloring Page
pages.description: Green Shadow unleashes Precision Blast in this printable coloring page, wearing her pointed mask and flowing cape as a long projectile extends from her flared snout. A round clasp with a leaf emblem fastens the cape. Sharp blast strokes contrast with the broad fabric folds on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Peashooter Spitting a Chili Bean Bomb Toward a Foot Soldier Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Garden Warfare Peashooter spitting a Chili Bean Bomb toward a Foot Soldier Zombie, with the bean arcing above the soldier's helmet. The zombie holds a tubular weapon and wears a backpack. Its boot laces and the bomb's curled fuse add smaller coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Peashooter Rooted in Pea Gatling Mode While Defending a Garden Capture Point Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter defends a garden capture point in this printable coloring page, rooted in Pea Gatling mode with clustered barrels firing beside a small flag and circular flower bed. Leafy headgear surrounds its rounded head. The coloring sheet includes flowers, a picket fence, and small stones around the plant's base.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Peashooter Using Hyper to Leap Over a Low Garden Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: A Garden Warfare Peashooter uses Hyper to leap over a low fence in this printable coloring page, lifting its leafy base above the pointed wooden pickets below. Curved motion strokes follow the jump beside its bent stem. The coloring sheet gives its head, flared snout, and leaves broad open interiors.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Battle for Neighborville Peashooter Hovering Above Giddy Park with Pea Suped Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter hovers over Giddy Park using Pea Suped in this printable coloring page, with its base leaves spread above a Ferris wheel and striped tent below. Curved strokes surround the leaves and trail beneath the stem. Small wheel cabins and a star-shaped hub add background detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Toxic Pea Firing a Toxic Pea Surrounded by Curling Gas Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Toxic Pea fires a projectile surrounded by curling gas clouds in this printable coloring page, with smaller rounded vapor shapes rising around its long stem and base. Pointed leaves fan behind its head. The coloring sheet combines broad plant shapes with spiral gas outlines and a few grass tufts.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Agent Pea with Slick Leaf Hair and a Bow Tie Aiming at a Scientist Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: Agent Pea faces a Scientist Zombie in this printable coloring page, aiming its long snout beneath swept leaf hair while a bow tie wraps around its stem. The scientist wears goggles above unruly hair and holds a tubular weapon. Hedge leaves and paving cracks supply finer coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Law Pea Wearing a Cowboy Hat with a Sheriff Star in a Western Standoff Coloring Page
pages.description: Law Pea stands ready for a Western standoff in this printable coloring page, wearing a sheriff-star cowboy hat above a curved mustache and spotted neckerchief at its stem. Wooden storefronts line the background beside a tumbleweed. Broad hat sections contrast with the smaller badge and bandana shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Commando Pea Wearing a Bandana While Firing a Rapid Burst Coloring Page
pages.description: Commando Pea fires a rapid burst in this printable coloring page, wearing a tied bandana beneath a tall fan of pointed leaves on its rounded head. Four peas travel upward with short motion strokes. The coloring sheet includes a curved stem, broad base leaves, and scattered grass.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare Plasma Pea Charging a Large Swirling Plasma Orb at the End of Its Snout Coloring Page
pages.description: Plasma Pea charges a swirling orb in this printable coloring page, with star and circle markings decorating its head and tall leaves behind its narrowed eyes. Curved bands spiral through the large projectile. Smaller stars and sparks surround the orb on a mostly open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter in Icy Cavern Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter stands inside an icy cavern in this printable coloring page, framed by hanging icicles and pointed formations rising behind its broad head and curved stem. Scattered stones sit across the cave floor. Thin rock cracks surround the heavier character outlines on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter on Lawn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page centers a Peashooter on a lawn, with small side leaves sprouting from its stem beneath a large head and flared circular snout. Grass tufts surround the broad base leaves. Low bushes and a partly visible house outline form the coloring sheet's simple background.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter in Pyramid Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter stands among pyramid ruins in this printable coloring page, with a cracked stone arch, carved wall symbols, and a crescent moon above the distant pyramid. Its smiling face and broad base leaves fill the foreground. Broken paving and masonry joints add smaller coloring sheet sections.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter in Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A potted Peashooter occupies an enchanted forest in this printable coloring page, surrounded by spotted mushrooms beneath a smiling crescent moon and small stars between leafy trees. Spiral markings decorate the pot and nearby trunk. Broad foliage contrasts with mushroom gills and scattered stones on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter in Jungle Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Peashooter standing in jungle ruins, framed by a broken stone arch with hanging vines and broad plants growing beside cracked masonry. Small side leaves extend from its upright stem. Floor cracks, loose stones, and narrow vine loops add finer coloring sheet details.
